title: P = NP iff every bounded verifier admits polynomial-time optimization under a strict comparator
claims: OptimalComparatorWitnessSearch proves an equivalence between P = NP and extracting an undominated bounded witness for any reference polynomial-time strict transitive comparison relation.
No computable numerical or word-valued objective is assumed, and neither side is proved unconditionally.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
